title: Scapular Dyskinesis Assessment
author: Denise Martineli Rossi1
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.imycc7w

steps.title: Prepare Participants for Assessment
steps.instruction: Position the participants in the starting posture for the scapular dyskinesis assessment.

substeps.instruction: Instruct participants to stand in a relaxed position.
Ensure arms are at the sides, elbows are straight, and shoulders are in neutral rotation.

steps.title: Assign Weighted Loads
steps.instruction: Provide dumbbells based on the participant's body mass.

substeps.instruction: Assign 1.5-kg dumbbells to participants weighing <68.1 kg.
Assign 2.5-kg dumbbells to participants weighing ≥68.1 kg.

steps.title: Perform Arm Elevation and Lowering
steps.instruction: Execute a series of weighted arm movements.

substeps.instruction: Instruct participants to raise both arms above the head simultaneously as much as possible within a 2-s period.
Instruct participants to lower the arms over 2 s.
Complete one series of 8–10 cycles of elevation and lowering.

steps.title: Position and Conduct Rater Observation
steps.instruction: Observe the scapula from the posterior view without physical contact.

substeps.instruction: Stand approximately 2 m behind the participants.
Move freely to observe the scapula from any point in the posterior frontal and sagittal planes.
Avoid performing other evaluations, such as palpation.
Perform assessments simultaneously and independently, ensuring results are not communicated and notes are obscured from other raters using a folder.

steps.title: Classify Scapular Dyskinesis
steps.instruction: Evaluate the observed movements using the specified classification sequence.

substeps.instruction: Define scapular dyskinesis (SD) using the Yes/No classification.
If SD is 'Yes', identify the specific altered scapula movement (Type 1, 2, or 3).
Judge the degree of observed abnormal movements as either 'obvious' or 'subtle'.
If SD is 'No', classify as Type 4 and 'normal' for the scapular dyskinesis test classification.
